# cleura_gardener_shoot_oidc_kubeconfig (Data Source)

Fetches a kubeconfig that signs in to a Gardener cluster through one issuer of its [authentication configuration](../resources/gardener_authentication_configuration.md), using one of the issuer's audiences as the OIDC client ID.
The cluster must have `authentication_configuration_name` set.

The kubeconfig contains no secret.
It runs the [kubelogin](https://github.com/int128/kubelogin) plugin (`kubectl oidc-login`), which opens the identity provider in a browser on first use and caches the token.
Everyone who uses it signs in as themselves, and it doesn't expire, so it can be distributed freely.
It only works once the cluster has finished applying its configuration; a kubeconfig fetched earlier is refused at sign-in until then.

Set `authentication_configuration_name` to the configuration resource when the same apply changes that configuration, for example adds the audience.
Terraform then reads the kubeconfig after the change rather than during planning.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A kubeconfig that signs in to the cluster through Keycloak, with "kube-api"
# as the OIDC client ID. It holds no secret: kubectl opens the browser through
# the kubelogin plugin (kubectl oidc-login) on first use.
data "cleura_gardener_shoot_oidc_kubeconfig" "sso" {
  project_id   = cleura_gardener_shoot.example.project_id
  shoot_name   = cleura_gardener_shoot.example.name
  issuer_alias = "keycloak"
  audience     = "kube-api"

  # Set when the same apply changes the configuration, for example adds the
  # audience, so the kubeconfig is fetched after that change.
  authentication_configuration_name = cleura_gardener_authentication_configuration.sso.name
}

resource "local_sensitive_file" "kubeconfig" {
  content  = data.cleura_gardener_shoot_oidc_kubeconfig.sso.kubeconfig
  filename = "${path.module}/example-cluster-oidc.kubeconfig"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `audience` (String) One of the issuer's `audiences`, used as the OIDC client ID.
- `issuer_alias` (String) Alias of the issuer to sign in through: a key of the configuration's `issuers`.
- `shoot_name` (String) Name of the cluster.

### Optional

- `authentication_configuration_name` (String) The authentication configuration the cluster uses. Normally read from the cluster; set it to `cleura_gardener_authentication_configuration.<name>.name` when the same apply changes that configuration (for example adds the audience), so the kubeconfig is fetched after the change. It must match the configuration attached to the cluster.
- `project_id` (String) OpenStack project of the cluster. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<project_id>/<shoot_name>/<issuer_alias>/<audience>`.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) The kubeconfig, as YAML.
